## Superpower: The Visionary Cheerleader

As an ENFP, Chris possesses an almost superpower-like ability to see people's hidden potential:

::: {.comic-grid}
::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
FEATURE 01: UNCONDITIONAL BELIEF
:::
### The Hype Machine
When you share a dream, project, or secret ambition, Chris won't scoff. He will immediately map out the possibilities, brainstorm ideas, and champion you relentlessly.
:::

::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
FEATURE 02: SYMBOLIC ROMANCE
:::

Chris doesn't do generic romantic gestures. He remembers obscure details, builds customized playlists, creates personalized gifts, and turns ordinary dates into memorable quests.

## Travel & Expedition Mode

How Chris behaves when out in the wild on vacation:

| Behavior Dimension | Chris's Default Setting | Survival Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Airport Timing** | Strategic & Timely *(Comfortable margin)* | Keep passport and boarding pass in designated pocket. |
| **Itinerary Style** | **Structured Spontaneity:** High-level anchors + open slots for serendipity. | Hates having every 15 minutes rigidly scheduled. |
| **Culinary Exploration** | Enthusiastic foodie, seeks local gems and hidden street food. | Never take Chris to a generic airport chain restaurant if authentic local food is nearby. |
| **Energy Battery** | High exploratory stamina until sudden 5:00 PM wall. | Schedule mandatory coffee / pastry recharge breaks. |
